we propose a new methodology for PHM of roller bearing that combines the data-driven and experience based approaches.
the use of hidden Markov models and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inferences system can improve the prognostics of bearing failures.
1) the proposed methodology is able to detect the degradation state in bearings, 2) it can estimate the imminence of next degradation state, and 3) the remaining useful life of the bearings.

the development of a new methodology that can be applied to any kind of bearing and can be used in real-time.
the use of the adaptive neuro-fusion inference system and hidden Markov models for the PHM.
the development and validation of a methodology to predict failures in rolling bearings using a combination of data-driven and knowledge-based techniques.

the methodology proposed in the paper is an effective approach for the PHM in roller bearings.
the use of hidden Markov models in the proposed methodology allows the prediction of the next degradation stage in bearings and the remaining time to failure.
the use of hidden Markov models in combination with adaptive neuro-fuzzy systems is an effective approach to estimate the imminence of failure of bearings.
